items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: HINTON: We became the New York rhythm section. ... I got Osie and I said, 'Osie, you'll have to do these things.'

ctx.x: Osie Johnson. I said, "Now, old gal, you got the music, because I don't want no dumb drummers around me. You learn C and G; you going to know full chords; you going to know diminished chords." He said, "I don't know nothing about no drums." I said, "Come on, now." He kept fooling around and fooling around and when the thing come to a head - you remember, you and I had a thing we were going to go around and show somebody how to play with the rhythm section. I suggested to you, now there's no way in the world you…
here and you didn't care what the other people played. You'd know what you were going to play. HINTON: We became the New York rhythm section.
